visualCharacteristics.summary: Sticky horizontal in-page tab bar (Why Us, What You Get, FAQs, Quick Links) with the active tab underlined and an optional Apply Now button on the right.

contentPattern.structure: One cell (or one row per tab) with a list of links to in-page anchors (#why-us). Any link that is not an in-page anchor becomes the CTA button (e.g. Apply Now).

usage: Product and program pages: a sticky bar of jump links to the page's sections (targets are heading or section ids), with the active section highlighted while scrolling and an optional Apply Now CTA.

suitableFor: long product / offer detail pages with named sections
pages needing a persistent Apply Now CTA
notSuitableFor: cross-page navigation (use header nav or quick links)
tabbed panels that hide content (use a tabs block)
